excluded_measurements.reason: receiver did not provide a complete finite measurement vector

split_manifest.split_policy: Entire virtual recording sessions; train60/validation20/test20 percent (minimum two validation/test sessions).
split_manifest.nuisance_policy: Gain .45-.85, phase -180..180deg and delay13..80samples are drawn once per session and shared by every class; SNR24..34dB and nominal CFO+-2Hz shared per window. Nominal ADC rail4 provides headroom even for the low-SNR experiment.
split_manifest.feature_boundary: Only FEATURE_NAMES, measured from received samples, enter the model. Labels/settings/session IDs/seeds/metrics are excluded.
split_manifest.limitation: Classifier scores condition on acquired captures with complete measured features. Failed acquisitions are recorded separately, never filled with fabricated features. Synthetic sessions share one simulator; performance is not hardware accuracy.

interpretation: Both scores classify the same heldout virtual sessions before abstention. Similar or better rules performance is a valid outcome; no AI advantage is assumed.
limits: One simple synthetic channel; no real hardware captures.
Four controlled single-impairment classes; not universal root-cause diagnosis.
Random forest support is not calibrated confidence.
Do not tune the model from these test results; create a new independent test set for later iterations.
